@MilkRoadDaily @JSeyff @EricBalchunas The likelihood of ETFs on Litecoin, Solana, XRP and Dogecoin appearing in 2025 is an important signal for the market. 

 Litecoin leads with 90%, Dogecoin with 75%. This shows that cryptocurrencies are becoming more and more integrated into traditional financial systems.
@unusual_whales This is an interesting move that could strengthen Dogecoin's legitimacy as a payment instrument.
